rows.note: Use 自由 as the all-purpose noun for being free or lacking constraints.

example.english: During my days off, I have the freedom to arrange my own time.
example.traditional: 放假嗰幾日，我可以自由安排時間。
example.jyutping: fong3 gaa3 go2 gei2 jat6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 on1 paai4 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use 使用權 for a right or privilege to use or access a resource.

example.english: The freedom to use this database is limited to postgraduate students.
example.traditional: 呢個資料庫嘅使用權只限研究生。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi1 liu2 fu3 ge3 si2 jung6 kyun4 zi2 haan6 jin4 gau3 saang1
